RainbowFalls_Text_Npc0.en: A rainbow every morning. I never\nget tired.
RainbowFalls_Text_Npc0.fr: Un arc-en-ciel chaque matin. Je ne\nm'en lasse jamais.

RainbowFalls_Text_Npc1.en: MILOTIC is the most beautiful thing\nI have seen.
RainbowFalls_Text_Npc1.fr: MILOBELLUS est la plus belle chose\nque j'aie vue.

RainbowFalls_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

RainbowFalls_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
